title: Share the fresh-row quotient radix traversal (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped proof with a constructive opt-in implementation: share the encoded radix traversal in `fresh_rows.quotient`, retaining every division by the original small constant q. This answers Open next question 2 of Brian's #4794.

```text
original: m^2 traversals, each containing w-1 small-q divisions
candidate: one traversal containing m^2 divisions at each of w-1 yields
```

The Count division sequence, returned tape, divisibility domain and full Count record invoice agree. Successful residue savings are exactly `(m^2-1) rho(q,w,L)`, where rho is one complete validated radix traversal with cleanup. Divisor widths and peak simultaneous residue inventory are unchanged. ToikY #4025 supplies loop interchange at the directory port; the new step is the actual fresh-row quotient port and its complete local invoice.

Only `research/r437-shared-radix-quotient/` is added. Produced by Nick Petalas. Credit David Arias #2753, ToikY #4025, ywz65 #2590/#2566, Chris R #4062, Tekalign #4077, Brian #4794 and the retained caller/stock/construction lineage in the README.

## Evidence

- Before, q3/m2/w2 residue reads/writes/moves are `(7256,1376,7456)`; after, `(1814,344,1864)`. Both Count invoices are `(495,111,456)`, including output disposal, and both residue peaks are nine with an unrelated dirty word present.
- Eight exact accepted binary-tape cases include q2/3/5, dimensions 1/2/3/64, exponents 1/2/3/4 and the real GL64 low factor at w1. Eleven rejected inputs preserve the first failed predicate and division trace. Four controls detect omitted/extra division, skipped validation and an undercharged retained traversal.
- Warning-strict normal and optimized local checks pass with identical generated source-bound receipts. Each registered command takes about 0.5 seconds locally and has a 60-second limit. Package metadata/replay passes; all 17 committed package/input files and their canonical source ancestry pass preflight. Official export integrity and normal/optimized read-only Git-free replay pass, with all 18 export files unchanged.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/r437-shared-radix-quotient
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/r437-shared-radix-quotient/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/r437-shared-radix-quotient/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/r437-shared-radix-quotient --check-source-history
```

Expected verifier marker: `PASS_R437_SHARED_RADIX_QUOTIENT cases=8 rejections=11 controls=4`.

## Limitations

The harness supplies the consumed context attributes with actual Ring and Count implementations and exact GL cardinalities. Full Context construction, Machine.node, the downstream 9475 guard, Program/payload, recursion and admitted-root composition remain unrun. The interval includes quotient execution and returned-Count disposal; context/input construction and borrowed-state disposal lie outside it. Malformed modulus contexts are excluded, preserving the predecessor's reported cleanup limitation. No exception-time saving formula is claimed.

Exact source operations do not establish a physical-machine tariff, full supplier, new kappa or multiplication theorem. No predecessor package verifier, Lean build, Docker run or historical suite is run. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. The written proof covers valid fixed contexts; finite checks corroborate that proof.

## Related open work

- #4794 studies this same fresh-row quotient using the enlarged constant q^(m^2). This PR implements its explicit small-q shared-traversal alternative. No full paid crossover comparison is claimed; its reported numbers are cited rather than recomputed.
- #4793 executes the R437 nonzero-high leaf payload and consumer. It concerns the downstream payload obligation; this PR stops at the quotient port and computes no corresponding payload count.
- #4172 studies native-history allocator/codec coupling and the QQ16 comparison. It is a separate caller-cost boundary and supplies no common quotient invoice compared here.

Before DONE, this account's open PRs created since the CLAIM at 2026-10-22T21:49:35Z were refreshed. The nine other submissions, #4844, #4845, #4846, #4847, #4849, #4850, #4851, #4852 and #4855, concern center-output compression, a CRT batch bill, UT3 tariffs/couplings, fixed-factor workspace, weighted reversals, S3 rigidity, elimination downsets and block-four leakage. None studies this fresh-row quotient invoice or supplies a competing value for these fixtures. No additional numerical comparison was run.

## Open next questions

1. Compose this adapter with an actual admitted caller, preserving the stock guard, complete payload and cleanup.
2. Price the small-q and large-divisor alternatives under one physical control, amortization and storage contract.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks passed on exact head `2877e4920338d9a2e56aa960bdb5663f8f96b2d8` in [run 39861270310](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39861270310): plan in 3m9s and registered package replay in 4m28s. The replay executes both warning-strict normal and optimized commands. Run metadata confirms that head and a successful conclusion. Local registered replay, committed-byte/source-history preflight and read-only Git-free export replay also passed. Hosted execution is bounded automated verification; independent human and formal proof-kernel review remain unclaimed.

[Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19133388). Canonical source baseline is `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`, priority revision 7, refreshed unchanged before publication. Sparse-note and unpublished-work coverage is incomplete.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. **Blast Radius:** isolated research package. The adapter is opt-in; shared sources and the selected frontier are unchanged.
